text: Former members are numbered differently in the expense form than on the list and balances, both clients
relates: T-196 (same file on the web, ExpenseDialog.tsx labelFor)

Fixed in 76ab0f7: the form takes the list-wide numbering on both clients — web ExpenseDialog gets a formerNumbers prop from ExpenseListPage/BalancesPage; Android ExpenseFormViewModel.loadList computes it across the list via the extracted expenseRowsOf(). Rule left as first appearance newest-first (both clients agree). Web and Android tests pin it (the form used to say 3 where the list said 1); each fails with its fix reverted.
